tei:div.tei:p: 293)༄༅/ bstod pa'i tshogs rin chen gser gyi mchod sdong zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 294)na maḥshākya mu na ye/ gser mdog lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// 'jig rten gsum na 'gran zla kun bral zhing*// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug brgyan mchog gyur pa// thub dbang zhabs kyi pad mor gus phyag 'tshal// nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong rab bcom zhing*// skyon bral mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i sku// skye med chos skur mya ngan las 'das pa// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das la 'dud// khyed nyid sngon tshe rdza mkhan bur gyur tshe// bde gshegs shāka thub chen po de nyid la/ gus 294)pa'i sems kyis rdza phor gcig phul nas// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed mdzad der 'dud// gang tshe khyed ni dga' ldan zhing khams nas// glang chen thal dkar mchog tu sku sprul pa// ser skya'i grong du zas gtsang sras nyid du// 'gro ba'i mgon nyid lhums su zhugs der 'dud// zla bcu lon tshe btsun mo sgyu 'phrul ma// lho phyogs lumbh-i'i tshal byon bzhugs pa'i tshe// rtsibs logs g.yas nas yum la gnod med par/ ltas bzang bcas te bltams par mdzad der 'dud// bltams ma thag tu phyogs bzhir 296)byon la las// zhabs kyi rjes la padma'i sdong po 'khrungs// lha dbang klu rgyal sogs kyi phyag byas shing*// 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur khyed la 'dud// de nas rig gnas slob pa'i grwar byon nas// kun gyi bshes gnyen zhes bya'i slob dpon la// yig brtsis rig gnas 'phong dang sgyu rtsal kun// thogs med gzhan nas lhag par mkhyen der 'dud// grags 'dzin ma dang sa mtsho ri dwags skyes// btsun mo drug khri'i tshogs dang rol mdzad cing*// slar yang thams cad snying po med dgongs nas// rgyal srid longs spyod spangs bar mdzad la 'dud// rab tu byung dgongs pho brang yang thog nas// rgyal chen bzhi sogs lha yis mchod pas bsus// rnam dag drung du nyid kyi dbu skra yang*// nyid kyi bcad cing rab tu byung la 'dud/

nairañdzā na'i 'gram du gshegs pa'i tshe// lo drug bar du khams kyi zas spangs te// stan thog gcig tu g.yo mgul tsam med par/ 297) /ting 'dzin ngang du g.yo med bzhugs der 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub rab bskul zhing*// rtswa yi chun bu stan du bsnams nas kyang*// ma ga dha yi rdo rje'i gdan steng du// byang chub snying por gshegs par mdzad la 'dud// 'od zer spros pas bdud kyi gnas krog cing*// bdud dang brtsod de sa lhas dpang mdzad de// bdud dmag rnams kyi g.yo bar ma nus pa'i// bdud las rgyal ba'i mgon po de la 'dud// tho rangs dus su mngon par sangs rgyas te// me tog char babs sa chen rab tu g.yos// lha mi kun gyi ngo mtshar mchog gyur pa// 'gro ba'i bla ma bcom ldan 'das la 'dud// tshangs pas bskul zhing wa ra ṇa si ru// 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos gsungs tshe// lnga sde bzang po lha bran brgyad khri kun// bden pa mthong bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// bya rgod 298)spungs rir chos 'khor bar ba'i tshe// sku las 'od zer grangs med phyogs bcur 'phros// ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*// thams cad bde la 'khod par mdzad der 'dud// lha gnas klu gnas grong khyer padma can// chos 'khor mtha' ma nges don snying po gsungs// sku las 'od spros 'od rtser pad sdong la// sangs rgyas sku bzhugs rdzu 'phrul bstan la bdud// nam zhig 'dus byas mi rtag brdas bstan phyir// dgung lo brgyad bcur grong khyer rtswa mchog tu// me tog char babs sa chen g.yos gyur cing*// yongs su mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sku gdung ring bsrel cha brgyad rab tu bgos// yul phyogs brgyad kyi rgyal pos so sor 'khyer// dad pa'i rten du sa steng kun tu khyab// tshogs gnyis zhing du gyur la phyag 'tshal 'dud// de ltar khyed kyi yon tan rgya mtsho las// cung zad tsam zhig bdag gi bstod pa'i mthus// 'gro kun

299)'khor ba'i 'dam las thar nas kyang*// phyir mi ldog pa bde chen sa thob shog /gzhan yang dge des dus rnams thams cad du// nag phyogs bdud kyi phyogs rnams pham byas shing*// 'gro mgon khyed kyi bstan pa'i 'di nyid ni// nub pa med par gong nas gong 'phel shog /'jig rten khams 'dir 'khrugs rtsod mu ge dang*// rims nad la sogs mi mthun kun zhi nas// 'gro rnams bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// mthar thug mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shog ༈ 'jam dpal dbyangs la bstod pa nor bu'i dra ba zhes bya ba/ ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ mkhyen rab shes bya'i mkha' klong yangs pa las// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rta bdun 'od zer gyis// 'gro blo'i ma rig mun pa sel mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud// pad zla'i steng na chu shel ltar dkar zhing*/ 300) /dbu rgyan mgul rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub dang*// se mo do dang rin chen do shal sogs// sna tshogs brgyan gyi mdzes par spras pa 'dud// 'od zer 'bum phrag phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas// 'gro kun ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob mdzad cing*// bde chen thar pa'i gling du 'dren pa yi// rnam grol lam ston 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud// mtshan dpes rab brgyan ston zla ltar mdzes shing*// yan lag drug bcu'i chos smra legs sgrogs mdzad// mkhyen brtse ye shes mchog gi thugs mnga' ba// 'gran zla kun bral 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud// nam mkha'i 'ja' 'am chu zla ji bzhin du// bag chags mtshan ma'i ngos bzung dang bral zhing*// snang stong skye med dbyings las skur sprul pa// sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud// sna tshogs 'ja' 'od sprin phung 'khrig pa'i dbus/ 'od lnga'i lha mo mdzes pa'i gar stabs can// spos 201)dang me tog rol mo'i bye brag gis// kun nas mchod pa de la phyag 'tshal 'dud// mgon po khyed kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug thibs po kun bsal nas// rab bzang blo yi padmo rgyas gyur cing*// mkhyen rab chu gter che la mnga' brnyes shog

/brtse ldan khyed kyi thugs rje yis// bdag sogs 'gro kun rjes bzung ste// sdug bsngal 'di las thar nas kyang*// khyed dang dbyer med 'gyur bar shog ༈ na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ gang gi thugs rje pad dkar dri med las// dngos grub mdzad med sbrang rtsa'i bcud chen gyis// rkang drug dad ldan gdul bya tshim mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig spyan ras gzigs la 'dud// bcom ldan tshe dpag med dang rdo rje 'chang*// snang mtha' rigs lnga kun bzang shākya thub// sangs rgyas stong sogs dus gsum rgyal kun gyi// thugs rje gcig bsdus spyan ras gzigs 302)la 'dud// 'gro drug kun dang khyad par bod khams 'di// nyid kyis gdul bya'i zhing du gyur gzigs nas// dus rnams rtag tu thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// yongs su bzung mdzad spyan ras gzigs la 'dud// me yi 'obs dang khri mun chud 'dra ba'i// sdug bsngal 'dam du mnar ba'i 'gro ba kun// khyed kyi thugs rje brtse bas ma skyabs na// mgon med nyams thag sems can su la re// thugs rje chen pos bdag sogs rjes bzung nas// ri dwags rgyar chud lta bu'i 'gro ba kun// myur ba nyid du khyed gyi zhabs drung du// skyes nas chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /de ltar skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du// mgon dang dpung gnyen bla mar khyed gyur cing*// bdag kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob nas// myur du gzhan don byed la mnga' brnyes shog ༈ sgrol ma la bstod pa lha'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la 303) phyag 'tshal lo/ rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur bcom ldan thugs rje can// 'gro ba rnams la ma ltar brtse ba'i thugs mnga' zhing*// dus rnams kun tu sems can don la rab brtson mdzad// thugs rje'i bdag nyid rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ pad zla'i steng na tām̐yig dag las skur sprul pa/

sku mdog sngo ljang bcu drug na tshod dang ldan zhing*// dar gyi na bza' rin chen 'phreng ba do shal sogs// sna tshogs brgyan gyis mdzes par spras pa de la 'dud// gang na su zhig khyed kyi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang*// de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa// mi mthun gnod pas phyogs rnams kun las thar mdzad pa// skyabs kyi mchog gyur rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud// deng 'dir khyed la cung zad bstod pa'i bsod nams des// tshe rabs kun tu 'phags ma khyed kyis rjes bzung ste// srid dang ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa kun 304)las thar nas kyang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa myur du thob par shog ༈ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ stobs bcu'i stobs kyis bdud rnams rab bcom zhing*// byams ldan byams pa'i thugs kyis 'gro rnams la// brtse ldan brtse bas rjes su bzung mdzad pa// thugs rje thugs mnga' de la gus pas 'dud// gang tshe 'dren mchog bla ma khyed nyid ni// gang dag sem can rnams gyi don slad du// gang la gang 'dul gzugs su sprul nas kyang*// gang 'dir 'gro don g.yel med mdzad la 'dud// sgrib gnyis bag chags thams cad rab sbyangs shing*// sgrib tshogs ma lus rang sar dag mdzad pa/ sgrib sogs skyon gyi ma gos chos kyi rje/ sgrib pa kun bral bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mkhyen brtse nus pa ma lus phul phyin zhing*// mkhyen rab shes bya'i don la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ mkhyen ldan 'gro ba'i don mdzad chos kyi rje/ 305) /mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// legs sku bsod nams brgya las grub pa'i sku// legs bshad rgya mtsho snyan par sgrog pa'i gsungs// legs par brtags kyang skyon dang bral ba'i thugs// legs pa'i lam ston bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// khyed ni 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas dam pa de// khyed kyi mtshan thos mthong dang reg pas kyang*// khyed nyid lta bu'i 'gro don nus pa dang*// khyed bzhin chos kyi mtshan nyid rab rtogs shog

/sdug bsngal gyis gzir 'khor ba'i sems can kun// sdug bsngal 'dam chud slar yang chags pa la// sdug bsngal kun las skyabs mdzad khyod kyis ni// sdug bsngal 'di las thar bar mdzad du gsol// sa dang lam rnams rim gyis bgrod pa dang// sa lam bar chad 'gal rkyen kun zhi nas// sa bcu'i byang sems kun dang dgongs pa mnyam// sa gsum skye dgu'i 'dren par bdag gyur cig /rnam gsum tshul khrims 306)go cha rab bgos te// rnam mang 'gro blo'i skal ba dang 'tshams par// rnam dag chos kyi bdud rtsis smin byas shing*// rnam mkhyen sa la rang gzhan kun 'grod shog

de ltar 'di dag rnams ni rang lo bcu nas bcu dgu'i bar skabs rnams su brtsams pa'i sde mtshan yin tshe spyir bdag 'dra thos bsam gyi nor gyis dben cing*/ khyad par na gzhon byis pa'i rtsom par song ba'i dbang gis zlos dang 'gal rmongs kyi cha ci mchis thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan rnams la bzod par gsol zhes rang nyid snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs pa lags// maṅga laṃ//
